meta.name: canvas-design
meta.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据描述生成原创视觉设计图片和PDF文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成原创海报、艺术图或静态视觉设计。
copy.tagline_en: Create original visual art and PDF documents from descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate original posters, artwork, or static visual designs.

howto.what: 它会把你的要求先写成一份设计理念(.md),再据此创作一幅原创、以视觉为主的静态作品,输出 .pdf 或 .png;文字极少。不复制现有艺术家作品。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作海报、艺术品、设计等静态作品时触发;或当需要输出 .png/.pdf 视觉文件时。

say.text: 给我做一张海报,主题是城市夜生活。
say.note: 它会先生成设计理念,再输出 .png/.pdf 作品。

say.text: 为一本诗集设计封面,输出 PDF。
say.note: 按设计理念做单页视觉作品。

say.text: 做一个 3 页的 PDF,主题是“迁徙”。
say.note: 触发多页模式,各页风格统一又有变化。

howto.what_en: It turns your request into a design philosophy (.md), then creates an original, visual-first static artwork as a .pdf or .png; text is minimal. It does not copy existing artists' work.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece, or when a .png/.pdf visual file is needed.

say_en.text: Make a poster about city nightlife for me.
say_en.note: It writes the design philosophy first, then outputs a .png/.pdf piece.

say_en.text: Design a book cover for a poetry collection, output PDF.
say_en.note: Creates a single-page visual work following the design philosophy.

say_en.text: Make a 3-page PDF on the theme of migration.
say_en.note: Triggers multi-page mode with cohesive yet varied pages.
